digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command - mapping configuration diagnostics
propositions: Extend rebar doctor with mapping-diagnostics function to surface internally-invalid config errors and live drift findings in their own findings list
Offline checks must always run without jira-datacenter extra: validate mapping config load via MappingConfigError handling and run provider-neutral config resolvers per project key
All-empty projects.<KEY> stub blocks should emit a warning finding (not error) without blocking exit

Live-drift check must degrade gracefully when jira-datacenter extra is absent, PAT is empty, settings resolution fails, or probe transport times out - emitting single unavailable finding with reason and success exit
Live-drift detection via injected probe reader must compare configured vs observed vocabulary on status, type, and link axes while excluding hierarchy (Data Center hierarchyLevel is unobservable)
